what: GitHub's own records of who publishes BC's video poker verifier and when its card list changed, read on 17 Nov 2026 from GitHub's public API and from GH Archive (the hourly record of GitHub's public events, https://www.gharchive.org). Push times and fork dates are set by GitHub's servers when the push or fork happens; a commit's own date is set by whoever makes it. checks/check_history.py tests these records against verifier/versions/; checks/check_verifier_history_online.js reads them again from GitHub and GH Archive.
